# Data set 

Somatic mutations from exome sequencing data of both mice analyzed in MB208 up to now are analyzed here. 

```{r}
load("../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNA/hg38/ESGI_v2_Exome_Mutect2_hg38_Calls.Rdata")
all_variants$varID = paste(seqnames(all_variants),":",start(all_variants),"_",all_variants$REF,"/",unstrsplit(CharacterList(all_variants$ALT),sep = ","),sep="")

all_variants = all_variants[all_variants$sampleID != "4447_Q"] # sample with wrong patient assignation; also duplicate of 4447_F; both share the same clone-id 4A-2

all_variants$AF_rel = all_variants$AC / all_variants$DP

standard_chroms = standardChromosomes(all_variants)
standard_chroms = standard_chroms[!standard_chroms == "chrM"]
all_variants = all_variants[seqnames(all_variants) %in% standard_chroms]

anno_unique_sites_highest_impact[, varID := paste(CHROM,":",POS,"_",REF,"/",ALT,sep="")]
setkey(anno_unique_sites_highest_impact, varID)


ed = as.data.frame(read_excel("../../../../Data/Metadata/ClonalCultures/SampleDescription.xlsx", sheet = "DNA"), stringsAsFactors=F)
rownames(ed) = ed$DNA_ID
ed$SampleDesc = ed$SampleName
ed$SampleLabel = paste0(ed$SampleName, "_", ed$CloneID)
#tmp = strsplit(ed$SampleName," ")
#ed$Patient = unlist(sapply(tmp, `[`,AP11))
#ed$Condition = unlist(sapply(tmp, `[`,2))
ed <- subset(ed, DNA_ID %in% unique(all_variants$sampleID))
ed$not_first <- duplicated(ed$SampleDesc)

mcols(all_variants) = merge(mcols(all_variants), ed[, c("DNA_ID","SampleDesc","SampleLabel","Patient","Condition")], by.x="sampleID", by.y="DNA_ID", all.x=T, sort=F)

# keep only variants that are found in all technical replicates
tmp <- mcols(all_variants) |> as.data.table()
tmp[, sample_count_total:=.N, by=c("varID")]
tmp[, sample_count_sample_source:=.N, by=c("varID","SampleDesc")]

sample_source_cnts <- table(ed$SampleDesc)
tmp[, sample_source_cnt:=sample_source_cnts[SampleDesc]]
tmp$var_and_sampleID = paste0(tmp$varID, "__",tmp$sampleID)
setkey(tmp, "var_and_sampleID")

all_variants$var_and_sampleID = paste0(all_variants$varID, "__", all_variants$sampleID)
all_variants$sample_count_per_source <- tmp[all_variants$var_and_sampleID]$sample_count_sample_source
all_variants$tech_rep_count <- tmp[all_variants$var_and_sampleID]$sample_source_cnt

all_variants <- all_variants[all_variants$sample_count_per_source==all_variants$tech_rep_count]

mcols(all_variants)[["sample_count_per_source"]] <- NULL
mcols(all_variants)[["tech_rep_count"]] <- NULL
mcols(all_variants)[["var_and_sampleID"]] <- NULL

tt = table(names(all_variants))
sample_count = as.integer(tt)
names(sample_count) = names(tt)

all_variants$sample_count = integer(length(all_variants))
all_variants$sample_count = sample_count[names(all_variants)]

all_variants_cc <- all_variants
anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_cc <- anno_unique_sites_highest_impact
```

```{r}
sel_samples <- subset(ed, !not_first)$DNA_ID
all_variants_cc <- all_variants_cc[all_variants_cc$sampleID %in% sel_samples]
```


```{r}
all_variants_filtered_cc = all_variants_cc[all_variants_cc$DP < 200 & all_variants_cc$AF_rel > 0.25]
all_variants_filtered_cc_snv = all_variants_filtered_cc[all_variants_filtered_cc$vartype=="SNV"]
all_variants_filtered_cc_indel = all_variants_filtered_cc[all_variants_filtered_cc$vartype=="Indel"]
```


```{r}

# known SNP  (dbSNP-ID but no ClinVarID) or variant with > 1% AF (if known)
anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_cc$known_snp = with(anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_cc, ((!is.na(avsnp150) & is.na(CLNALLELEID)) | (is.na(avsnp150) & (!is.na(AF) & AF > 0.01)  ) ) ) 

anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_cc$known_clin_snp = with(anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_cc, (!is.na(CLNALLELEID) & !(CLNSIG %in% c("Benign","Benign/Likely_benign","Likely_benign"))  ) | !is.na(cosmic70)  )

anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_cc$known_bening_clin_snp = with(anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_cc, (!is.na(CLNALLELEID) & (CLNSIG %in% c("Benign","Benign/Likely_benign","Likely_benign"))  ) )


# Scores: CADD -> https://cadd.gs.washington.edu/, REVEL: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ajhg.2016.08.016, GERP++: info from ANNOVAR website
anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_cc$deleterious_variant = with(anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_cc, (!is.na(CADD_phred) & CADD_phred > 20 ) |  (!is.na(anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_cc$`GERP++_RS`) & anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_cc$`GERP++_RS`>2) | (!is.na(REVEL_score) & REVEL_score > 0.5)  | (!is.na(MetaLR_pred) & MetaLR_pred=="D")  ) 


all_variants_filtered_annotated_cc = merge(all_variants_filtered_cc, as.data.frame(anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_cc), by.x="varID", by.y="varID", all.x=T)
```



```{r}
# known SNP  (dbSNP-ID but no ClinVarID) or variant with > 1% AF (if known)
anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_pc$known_snp = with(anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_pc, ((!is.na(avsnp150) & is.na(CLNALLELEID)) | (is.na(avsnp150) & (!is.na(AF) & AF > 0.01)  ) ) ) 

anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_pc$known_clin_snp = with(anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_pc, (!is.na(CLNALLELEID) & !(CLNSIG %in% c("Benign","Benign/Likely_benign","Likely_benign"))  ) | !is.na(cosmic70)  )

anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_pc$known_bening_clin_snp = with(anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_pc, (!is.na(CLNALLELEID) & (CLNSIG %in% c("Benign","Benign/Likely_benign","Likely_benign"))  ) )


# Scores: CADD -> https://cadd.gs.washington.edu/, REVEL: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ajhg.2016.08.016, GERP++: info from ANNOVAR website
anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_pc$deleterious_variant = with(anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_pc, (!is.na(CADD_phred) & CADD_phred > 20 ) |  (!is.na(anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_pc$`GERP++_RS`) & anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_pc$`GERP++_RS`>2) | (!is.na(REVEL_score) & REVEL_score > 0.5)  | (!is.na(MetaLR_pred) & MetaLR_pred=="D")  ) 


```

```{r}
setkey(anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_pc, "varID")
af_eas <- anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_pc[names(all_variants_pc)]$AF_eas
all_variants_filtered_pc = all_variants_pc[all_variants_pc$DP < 200 & 
                                       all_variants_pc$AF_rel > 0.05 & 
                                       !anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_pc[names(all_variants_pc)]$known_snp & 
                                       (is.na(af_eas) | af_eas < 0.001) ] 
all_variants_filtered_pc_snv = all_variants_filtered_pc[all_variants_filtered_pc$vartype=="SNV"]
all_variants_filtered_pc_indel = all_variants_filtered_pc[all_variants_filtered_pc$vartype=="Indel"]
```


```{r}
all_variants_filtered_annotated_pc = merge(all_variants_filtered_pc, anno_unique_sites_highest_impact_pc, by.x="varID", by.y="varID", all.x=T)
```


```{r}
all_variants_filtered_annotated_cc$Cohort <- "CC"
all_variants_filtered_annotated_pc$Cohort <- "PC"
shared_cols <- intersect(colnames(all_variants_filtered_annotated_cc),colnames(all_variants_filtered_annotated_pc))
all_variants_filtered_annotated_combined <- rbind(all_variants_filtered_annotated_cc[, shared_cols], all_variants_filtered_annotated_pc[, shared_cols])
```

```{r}
all_variants_filtered_annotated_combined$clin_relevant_flag = with(all_variants_filtered_annotated_combined, (!(known_snp | known_bening_clin_snp)) & (HighestImpact %in% c("HIGH","MODERATE")) & (vartype=="Indel" | deleterious_variant  ) )
```

```{r}
known_cancer_drivers = as.data.frame(read_xlsx("/home/hilmar/Work/References/genesets/CancerDrivers/Baileys_et_al/mmc1.xlsx", sheet = 2, skip = 3))
```

```{r}
var_class_trans <- c("frameshift deletion"="Frame_Shift_Del","frameshift insertion"="Frame_Shift_Ins","nonframeshift deletion"="In_Frame_Del","nonframeshift insertion"="In_Frame_Ins","nonframeshift substitution","nonsynonymous SNV"="Missense_Mutation","startloss"="Silent","stopgain"="Nonsense_Mutation","synonymous SNV"="Silent","unknown"="Silent")

vars_to_maf <- function(x) {

  tmp <- strsplit(x$AAChange.refGene,";")
  tmp2 <- strsplit(sapply(tmp, `[`,1),":") 
  maf_input <- with(x, 
                    data.frame(Hugo_Symbol = ifelse(Func.refGene == "exonic",sapply(tmp2, `[`,1),"."),
                               Entrez_Gene_Id = NA,
                               Center = Cohort,
                               NCBI_Build = "GRCh38",
                               Chromosome = seqnames,
                               Start_Position = start,
                               End_Position = end,
                               Strand = "+",
                               Variant_Classification = var_class_trans[ExonicFunc.refGene],
                               Variant_Type = ifelse(vartype=="Indel", ifelse(Alt=="-","DEL","INS"), "SNP"),
                               Reference_Allele = Ref,
                               Tumor_Seq_Allele1 = Alt,
                               Tumor_Seq_Allele2 = Alt,
                               dbSNP_RS = ifelse(is.na(avsnp150), "novel", avsnp150),
                               Tumor_Sample_Barcode = sampleID,
                               Matched_Norm_Sample_Barcode = paste0("N_",sampleID),
                               Match_Norm_Seq_Allele1 = Ref,
                               Match_Norm_Seq_Allele2 = ".",
                               Tumor_Validation_Allele1=".",	
                               Tumor_Validation_Allele2=".",
                               Match_Norm_Validation_Allele1=".",
                               Match_Norm_Validation_Allele2=".",
                               Verification_Status="Unknown",
                               Validation_Status="Unknown",
                               Mutation_Status="Somatic",
                               Sequencing_Phase="X",
                               Sequence_Source="WES",
                               Validation_Method=".",
                               Score=NA,
                               BAM_file=NA,
                               Sequencer=".",
                               TranscriptID= sapply(tmp2, `[`,2),
                               Exon=sapply(tmp2, `[`,3),
                               ChromChange=sapply(tmp2, `[`,4),
                               AAChange = sapply(tmp2, `[`,5),
                               COSMIC_Codon=".",
                               COSMIC_Gene=".",
                               Drug_Target="."
                    ))
  clin_dat <- unique(x[, c("sampleID","Patient","Condition","Cohort")])
  colnames(clin_dat)[1] <- "Tumor_Sample_Barcode"
  #rownames(clin_dat) <- clin_dat$sampleID
  maf <- read.maf(maf_input, clinicalData =  clin_dat)
  return(maf)
}  
```


```{r}
maf <- vars_to_maf(all_variants_filtered_annotated_combined)

```

## Overview

### Annotation Type

```{r}
nr = elementNROWS(all_variants_filtered_annotated$AnnotationType)
```

# Rainfall plots

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ucsc <- function (x) 
{
    seqlevelsStyle(x) <- "UCSC"
    genome(x) = NA
    return(x)
}

ncbi <- function (x) 
{
    seqlevelsStyle(x) <- "NCBI"
    genome(x) = NA
    return(x)
}


gr = all_variants_filtered_snv
som_vr = VRanges(
  seqnames = seqnames(gr),
  ranges = ranges(gr),
  ref = gr$REF,
  alt = unstrsplit(CharacterList(gr$ALT),","),
  sampleNames = gr$SampleLabel,
  seqinfo = seqinfo(gr))
som_vr_ucsc = ucsc(som_vr)
som_vr_ucsc <- keepSeqlevels(som_vr_ucsc, seqlevels(som_vr_ucsc)[1:24])
vr_motifs = mutationContext(som_vr_ucsc, BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38, unify = TRUE)

```

```{r}
input = ncbi(vr_motifs)
#seqinfo(input) = seqinfo(all_region_results_ML)
samples = sort(unique(sampleNames(input)))
for(sa in samples) {
    print(plotRainfall(input[sampleNames(input) ==sa], group="alteration", main=sa))
}
```

# Clinically relevant somatic variants

```{r}


all_variants_filtered_annotated$clin_relevant_flag = with(all_variants_filtered_annotated, (!(known_snp | known_bening_clin_snp)) & (HighestImpact %in% c("HIGH","MODERATE")) & (vartype=="Indel" | deleterious_variant  ) )

clin_relevant_df  = subset(all_variants_filtered_annotated, clin_relevant_flag)
#xx = subset(all_variants_filtered_annotated, !clin_relevant_flag)


```

```{r}
samples_per_biopsy = apply(as.matrix(table(all_variants$SampleName, all_variants$sampleID))>0,1,sum)
var_per_biopsy = reshape2::dcast(clin_relevant_df, varID ~ SampleName, fun.aggregate = function(x) length(x), value.var = "sampleID" )

tmp = sweep(var_per_biopsy[,2:ncol(var_per_biopsy)], 2, samples_per_biopsy[colnames(var_per_biopsy[,2:ncol(var_per_biopsy)])], "/")
colnames(tmp) = paste0(colnames(tmp),"_proportion")
tmp$max_prop = apply(tmp, 1, max)
var_per_biopsy = cbind(var_per_biopsy, tmp)

#var_per_biopsy$max_count = apply(var_per_biopsy[,2:ncol(var_per_biopsy)], 1, max)

shared_vars_within_biopsy = subset(var_per_biopsy, max_prop > 0.6)


clin_relevant_shared_within_biopsy = merge(shared_vars_within_biopsy, anno_unique_sites_highest_impact, by.x="varID", by.y="varID", all.x=T)

```



## Genes mutated in both IM 592 and 594 in at least two samples per biopsy and clinically relevant mutation

```{r}
clin_relevant_shared_within_biopsy$IM_592_594 = ifelse(clin_relevant_shared_within_biopsy$`592 IM`+ clin_relevant_shared_within_biopsy$`594 IM` >0, T, F)
clin_relevant_shared_within_biopsy$nonIM_592_594 = ifelse(clin_relevant_shared_within_biopsy$`592 non-IM`+ clin_relevant_shared_within_biopsy$`594 non-IM` >0, T, F)

clin_relevant_shared_within_biopsy$IM_but_not_non_IM_592_594 = (clin_relevant_shared_within_biopsy$IM_592_594 & !clin_relevant_shared_within_biopsy$nonIM_592_594)

clin_relevant_shared_within_biopsy$known_driver = kcd_sw[clin_relevant_shared_within_biopsy$Gene.refGene, "Cancers"]

candidate_mutations_IM_592_594_only = subset(clin_relevant_shared_within_biopsy, IM_but_not_non_IM_592_594)
rownames(candidate_mutations_IM_592_594_only) = candidate_mutations_IM_592_594_only$varID

tmp = candidate_mutations_IM_592_594_only[, c("varID","Gene.refGene", "HighestImpact","AnnotationType","Func.refGene","ExonicFunc.refGene","AAChange.refGene", "known_driver")]

kable(tmp[order(tmp$Gene.refGene),])
```

# Status of mutated genes in all clones

```{r}
clin_variants_filtered = all_variants_filtered[all_variants_filtered$varID %in% candidate_mutations_IM_592_594_only$varID]
var_mat = table(names(clin_variants_filtered), factor(clin_variants_filtered$SampleLabel, levels=unique(sort(all_variants_filtered$SampleLabel))))
pheatmap(var_mat, scale="none", show_rownames = TRUE, cluster_cols=F, clustering_distance_rows = "correlation", labels_row = paste0(rownames(var_mat), " - ", candidate_mutations_IM_592_594_only[rownames(var_mat), "Gene.refGene"]))
```
